name: One by Allegro
author: One by Allegro

sections.description:
Oficiální plugin One by Allegro pro vytváření zásilek a správu nastavení dopravy One by Allegro ve vašem košíku. Vše co potřebujete na jednom místě pro tvorbu a zpracování zásilek, tisk štítků, objednání vyzvednutí a sledování statusu doručení.

Hlavní přednosti pluginu:

  • Jednoduchý přehled veškerých objednávek s dopravou One by Allegro.
  • Automaticky aktualizované stavy sledování zásilky .
  • Přímý odkaz na systém sledování zásilek.
  • Hromadné akce pro snadnou úpravu více zásilek najednou.
  • Hromadný tisk štítků.
  • Možnost zadání neomezeného počtu svozových míst.
  • Jednoduché objednání svozu pro jednu či více zásilek najednou.

The official One by Allegro plugin for creating shipments and managing One by Allegro shipping settings in your cart. Everything you need in one place for creating and processing shipments, printing labels, scheduling pickups, and tracking delivery status.

Main advantages of the plugin:

  • Simple overview of all orders with One by Allegro shipping.
  • Automatically updated shipment tracking statuses.
  • Direct link to the shipment tracking system.
  • Bulk actions for easy editing of multiple shipments at once.
  • Bulk label printing.
  • Option to add an unlimited number of pickup locations.
  • Easy scheduling of pickup for one or more shipments at once.

External services

This plugin connects to the OneDelivery API to manage parcel delivery services. The integration is required for creating shipments, generating labels, tracking parcels, and managing pickups.
Service: OneDelivery API (provided by Allegro) https://api.onedelivery.tech
Purpose: Parcel delivery management, shipment creation, label generation, pickup scheduling, and tracking
Data transmitted:

Parcel details (dimensions, weight, recipient information)
Pickup location data and scheduling requests
Shipment tracking requests
Label generation requests
Authentication credentials for API access

API endpoints used:

POST /parcels/shipments – Creates shipments
POST /parcels/shipments/labels – Generates shipment labels
GET /parcels/shipments/{shipmentId} – Retrieves shipment details
POST /parcels/pickups – Creates pickup requests
GET /parcels/pickups/proposals – Retrieves pickup proposals/availability
DELETE /parcels/pickups/{pickupId} – Deletes/cancels pickups
POST /parcels/auth/token – Generates authentication tokens
GET /parcels/tracking – Retrieves tracking information
GET /parcels/points – Retrieves list of pickup points with descriptions

Authentication: API requests require authorization tokens obtained through OneDelivery registration process.
Legal:

Privacy Policy: https://onedelivery.cz/gdpr
sections.installation:
Pro instalaci pluginu proveďte následující kroky:
Na kartě pluginu One by Allegro klikněte na tlačítko Install Now.
Na kartě pluginu po úspěšné instalaci klikněte na tlačítko Activate. Případně přejděte do sekce Plugins > Installed plugins. V seznamu pluginů nalezněte One by Allegro plugin a pod názvem pluginu klikněte na tlačítko Activate.
V levém hlavním menu se nyní zobrazila nová položka – One by Allegro. 
Nyní můžete začít s nastavením a používáním pluginu.

Detailní instrukce naleznete v našem Uživatelském manuálu.

To install the plugin, follow these steps:
On the One by Allegro plugin page, click the Install Now button.
After successful installation, click the Activate button on the plugin page. Alternatively, go to Plugins > Installed Plugins. In the list of plugins, find the One by Allegro plugin and click Activate under the plugin name.
A new item called One by Allegro will now appear in the main menu on the left.
You can now begin configuring and using the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

Release Date – July 18, 2025

Initial release of One by Allegro plugin
Full integration with OneDelivery API for shipment management
Automatic shipment tracking status updates
Bulk shipment creation and management
Bulk label printing functionality
Unlimited pickup location management
Easy pickup scheduling for single or multiple shipments
Direct integration with WooCommerce orders
Comprehensive shipment overview dashboard
Multi-language support (Czech/English)
Compatible with WordPress 6.7+ and WooCommerce
Secure API authentication with token management
GDPR compliance features
User-friendly interface with intuitive navigation
Comprehensive error handling and logging
Automated status synchronization with delivery service
Support for various parcel types and dimensions
Integration with WordPress admin menu system
Complete documentation and user manual included
